Marissa / Karthik / Naomi —

Fwd'ing Brightwell's note. They want capacity effective 2026-09-01 and prefer co-term with 2027-02-01. Two options outlined in the attached pricing grid (Brightwell_Uplift_Pricing_Grid.xlsx):

Option 1 — Short top-up (Sept–Jan):
- Additional 4 reserved GPUs (A100 class) for pilot window
- One-off prorated charge for 5 months
- No discount beyond standard commit band

Option 2 — Amortized uplift into renewal (co-term):
- Add 4 reserved GPUs immediately, amortize cost across remaining 5 months + extend renewal to 12 months from Feb 1
- Proposal: 7% uplift discount on the incremental capacity if we bundle with a 12‑month extension at current committed rate.

They've asked for staged billing support and potential credit offset. If we can offer 7% on the incremental piece and a one-time onboarding credit ($8k) to cover migration support, I think we land the pilot and position for full expansion in Q1.

Karthik — we may need a quick legal ok for the co-term language and the trial credit. Marissa — need your sign-off if we push the 7% and $8k credit. Naomi — after sign-off I will include CS onboarding scope.

Matt
